name: Post Matric Scholarship Students With Disabilities
nodalDept: Department Of Empowerment Of Persons With Disabilities
briefDescription: Post Matric Scholarship for Students with Disabilities provides financial assistance — maintenance allowance, reader allowance and other grants — to students with 40%+ disability pursuing Class 11 onwards through PhD at recognised Indian institutions.
descriptionMd:
The Post Matric Scholarship for Students with Disabilities (Post-DIS), run by the Department of Empowerment of Persons with Disabilities (DEPwD), Ministry of Social Justice & Empowerment, helps students with significant disabilities pursue education after Class 10 without financial hardship. The scholarship is available for any post-matric level — from Class 11 and 12, through polytechnic and diploma programmes, undergraduate and postgraduate degrees, up to PhD.

Disbursement is through the **National Scholarships Portal (NSP)** via Direct Benefit Transfer.
benefitsMd:
The scholarship has several components:

**Maintenance Allowance (₹/month):**
| Group | Hosteller | Day Scholar |
|-------|-----------|-------------|
| Group 1 (Medicine, Engineering, MBA, etc.) | ₹1,200 | ₹550 |
| Group 2 (Post-Grad non-Group 1) | ₹820 | ₹530 |
| Group 3 (Undergrad courses) | ₹570 | ₹300 |
| Group 4 (Class 11, 12, Certificate) | ₹380 | ₹230 |

**Additional allowances:**
- **Reader allowance:** ₹175/month for visually impaired students (blind).
- **Transport allowance:** ₹160/month for non-hostellers with locomotor/visual disability.
- **Helper allowance:** ₹160/month for severely orthopaedically handicapped students who cannot move around independently.
- **Coaching allowance:** ₹240/month for students undertaking approved coaching.
eligibilityMd:
- Must be a **student** pursuing a **post-matric qualification** (Class 11 and above, including polytechnics, diplomas, undergraduate, postgraduate and PhD) from a **UGC/AICTE-recognised** institution in India.
- Must have a **disability of at least 40%** with a valid disability certificate issued by a competent medical authority.
- Annual **parental/family income must not exceed ₹2.5 lakh**.
- The scholarship is available for students of **all disabilities listed under the RPwD Act 2016**.
exclusionsMd:
- Students pursuing distance/correspondence courses are **not** eligible.
- Students whose family income exceeds ₹2.5 lakh per annum are excluded.
applicationMd:
**Step 1:** Visit [scholarships.gov.in](https://scholarships.gov.in/) and click **'New Registration'**.
**Step 2:** Complete **One-Time Registration (OTR)** — enter your mobile, Aadhaar, email and bank details; verify OTP.
**Step 3:** Log in and choose **'Post Matric Scholarship for Students with Disabilities'** under 'Ministry of Social Justice & Empowerment'.
**Step 4:** Fill in the application — course, institution, disability details, income details.
**Step 5:** Upload documents — disability certificate (40%+), income certificate, Class 10/12 marksheets, current college admission/fee receipt, bank passbook.
**Step 6:** Submit before the annual deadline and track your application on the NSP dashboard. Your institution verifies and approves before disbursement.
